title: Candle flame frozen at the emitter's focal point

tellings.quote: Barry showed me he had one of the emitters it working. He put a lit little kitchen candle right at the focal point and he powered up the the reactor and the flame stopped flickering.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in the late 1980s at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, says a colleague named Barry Castilio showed him a working emitter, a part of the craft's power system. Lazar says Castilio put a lit kitchen candle right at the emitter's focal point, powered up the reactor, and the flame stopped flickering. Lazar tells this to Michels as something he saw himself; if true, the device did something strange to whatever sat in its field.
